observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a bare 4-cylinder engine block, removed from a vehicle, sitting on a shop floor.
Visible parts: valve cover with ignition coils, oil filler cap marked 'ENGINE OIL', alternator, serpentine belt pulleys, vacuum hoses.
A watermark reads 'EMMY GOLD AUTO SPARE' - this is the seller's shop branding, not a vehicle brand.
No engine code, VIN, or model plate is legible in either photo.
No shot of the underside, oil pan, timing cover, or any compression/startup test is included.
No packaging, import documents, or Belgian customs markings are visible despite the 'direct from Belgium' claim.
Seller's new message is a verbal reassurance only; no new photo or video was provided.

claims.evidence: Shape and coil pack layout in photo 0 and 1 are consistent with a Hyundai/Kia 4-cyl engine, but no stamped engine code or badge is visible to confirm exact model.
No import sticker, customs tag, or shipping documentation shown in either photo.

claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock (reaffirmed verbally: 'I tested it myself yesterday')
claims.evidence: Still no video or audio of the engine running; a verbal claim from the seller is not photographic or video proof and cannot be verified remotely.
No odometer, mileage sticker, or paperwork visible in either photo.
No close-up of head bolts, valve cover seals, or oil pan seam to check for tool marks or re-sealing.

risks.risk: Internal mechanical condition (compression, knocking, timing chain wear) cannot be judged from static photos or a verbal assurance.
risks.proof: A clear video clip of the engine cold-starting and idling, with audio.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / needing rebuild

risks.risk: Exact engine code/displacement is unknown, which drives price heavily across Hyundai/Kia range.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the stamped engine code plate, usually on the block near the bell housing.
risks.if_unproven: priced as the lowest-value generic small Hyundai/Kia 4-cyl engine

risks.risk: Mileage and import history (Tokunbo/Belgium claim) cannot be confirmed from photos or words alone.
risks.proof: Photo of import papers, customs tag, or odometer reading at time of removal.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown-mileage used engine, not low-mileage

risks.risk: Hidden damage to oil pan, timing cover, or wiring harness connectors not shown.
risks.proof: Additional photos of the underside, timing cover, and harness connectors.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming possible undisclosed damage in unseen areas

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the engine code/model stamp on the block.
Video of the engine cold-starting and running with audio.
Photo of the underside (oil pan, timing cover) and wiring harness connectors.
Any import/customs documentation or odometer/mileage sticker, if available.
response.reason: A verbal reassurance with no new photo or video does not change the evidence; the engine code needed to even set a worst-case price is still unreadable, and the 'tested working' claim remains unverifiable without a video or clip.
